instruction: I want to customize my bash prompt to show the current directory. Could you help me set the PS1 variable in my shell configuration to display the working directory in the prompt?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting PS1 prompt variable with \w (working directory) in .bashrc. Evaluator checks if PS1 line with \w exists in .bashrc. Similar pattern - modifying shell configuration file for customization.
